title: Law to help jailed voters fix ballot errors
summary: This bill would require the Department of Correction, working with the Board of Elections, to deliver notices of curable ballot defects to incarcerated voters and collect their signed corrections within 7 business days. It also requires the department to help voters get a new ballot when a defect cannot be cured. Starting January 1, 2027 the department must publish an annual report on cure notices, returns and uncounted ballots, without personal information.
